_howto: To publish a sample: put an MP4 (9:16, H.264, muted, <4 MB) into samples/, set src to '/samples/<file>.mp4' (and optional poster '/samples/<file>.jpg'), redeploy. build_netlify.py rewrites these root paths to /studio/samples/. Empty src = 'Ukázka brzy' placeholder. Preset ids must match data-slot in index.html. 25.10 samples: fictional unbranded products, generated locally (z-image-turbo still + LTX-2.5 image-to-video), receipt in docs/audits/2026-10-25-motion-studio-samples/receipt.json.
